- The slide deck is a hand-built, framework-free HTML/CSS/JS presentation (no Marp/reveal.js/Slidev).
- Slide markup lives in `slides/index.html`: one `<section class="slide">` per slide, in order.
- Styling lives in `slides/css/deck.css`: dark, high-contrast theme with gradient accents. Reuse the `.columns`/`.columns3` helpers and Font Awesome icon color classes defined there instead of adding new ones.
- Behavior lives in `slides/js/deck.js`: keyboard/touch navigation, URL hash deep-linking, progress bar, slide counter, fullscreen, overview mode, and the speaker-notes overlay.
- Speaker notes go in an `<aside class="notes">` block inside the relevant `<section class="slide">`. If a slide has multiple notes, merge them into a single `<aside class="notes">`.
- Font Awesome is loaded via the CDN `<link>` in `slides/index.html`; use `<i class="fa-brands fa-...">` icons as needed.
- Images/SVGs live in `slides/img` and are referenced with plain `<img>` tags.
- Slide decks and their assets should be stored in the `slides` directory.
